username.title: Choose a username

username.label: Username
username.terms: I have read and accept the terms of use and the privacy notice.

legal.draftNote: This text is a draft. The reviewed version replaces it before the public launch.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.p1: GMshield is a rules assistant for tabletop RPG game masters. You sign in with your Google account and choose a username.
terms.p2: Only send GMshield material you have the right to use, such as books you own or openly licensed texts. Each library is seen only by the person who created it.
terms.p3: The assistant's answers can contain mistakes. Check the cited source before deciding a rule at the table.
terms.p4: The service is under construction: features may change or be unavailable, with no guarantee of availability.
terms.p5: You can stop using GMshield whenever you want. An account that abuses the service may be blocked.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.p1: Of your personal data, GMshield keeps only the username, the email address and the identifier of your Google account, all three encrypted. It also records when you accepted the terms of use and this notice, and which version.
privacy.p2: Google learns that you use GMshield, because Google confirms your identity when you sign in.
privacy.p3: The questions you ask the assistant, with the passages of your material used to answer them, are processed by Microsoft's Azure OpenAI.
privacy.p4: Your material and notes are stored encrypted, and only you see them.
privacy.p5: Theme, language and session are kept in cookies of your browser that only the server reads. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.p6: This draft does not yet describe how long data is kept, how to delete the account, how to get in touch or your rights under the LGPD. The reviewed version will.
